items.question: What hidden initial SEB does damaged Staff.Init assign before the first native draw?
items.policy: Use explicit wait/move/typing fixture action; do not invent an initial selector.

items.question: What is the complete native Staff.Update cadence and transition timing?
items.policy: V6 closes deterministic selected frame and source-visible intervals; exact native cadence is deferred.

items.question: Does the general native Room.Draw call live Staff.Draw directly or through an Avatar relationship?
items.policy: The native avatar-primary slot and occlusion order are preserved; the live Staff-to-Avatar edge is not promoted.

items.question: What is the exact scale_ sentinel behavior in every Staff.Draw branch?
items.policy: V6 uses the explicit normal 100 percent command fixture; alternate scale branches remain isolated.

items.question: What are the native compositor/shader pixels for Staff layers, alpha, blend, and clipping?
items.policy: No pixel parity is claimed in V6.

items.question: How do gameplay route, desk, talk, and work simulation branches affect Staff visuals?
items.policy: Do not reuse gameplay simulation as visual authority.
